$comment: Accepted metric regressions for the release gate (bench/gates.py, bench/run.py --gate), relative to the previous release. Each entry: metric (a summary key of bench/report.py METRICS / SEQ_METRICS), scenario, optional config and solver (fnmatch patterns, default *), the ADR that justifies the change (a record docs/adr/<adr>.md; entries without one are ignored) and a reason. Example: {"metric": "placed_rate", "scenario": "05-airports", "config": "*", "solver": "rust", "adr": "placement/leaders", "reason": "..."}
